title.en: The first line of many files

hints.tr: `with ExitStack() as stack:` ve her dosya `stack.enter_context(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))`.
hints.en: `with ExitStack() as stack:` and each file `stack.enter_context(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))`.

hints.tr: Blok içinde `[f.readline().strip() for f in files]`.
hints.en: Inside the block, `[f.readline().strip() for f in files]`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
from contextlib import ExitStack


def first_lines(paths):
    with ExitStack() as stack:
        files = [stack.enter_context(open(p, encoding="utf-8")) for p in paths]
        return [f.readline().strip() for f in files]

print(first_lines(["part0.txt", "part1.txt", "part2.txt"]))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
from contextlib import ExitStack


def first_lines(paths):
    with ExitStack() as stack:
        files = [stack.enter_context(open(p, encoding="utf-8")) for p in paths]
        return [f.readline().strip() for f in files]

print(first_lines(["part0.txt", "part1.txt", "part2.txt"]))
```
